Scope: Finite native motif replacement, explicit non-draining neighbour observations, newly negotiated current-head seams and conserved delayed material passages. No measured energy or trained policy.

Cases.Name: One neighbour repairs a seam
Cases.Description: The left motif holds its handedness. Its neighbour reads the incompatible boundary offer, rebuilds as the reflected motif and republishes its actual ports. The waiting packet crosses on a later round.

Cases.Name: Fourfold cushion agreement
Cases.Description: All motifs begin with the same incompatible boundary offers. The centre holds its variant; local non-draining observations carry its constraint outward. Complete replacement motifs publish new ports, and queued packets wait for renewed seam acceptance.

Cases.Name: A field of interlocking keys
Cases.Description: All motifs begin with the same incompatible boundary offers. The centre holds its variant; local non-draining observations carry its constraint outward. Complete replacement motifs publish new ports, and queued packets wait for renewed seam acceptance.

Cases.Name: Rosette field with four held seams
Cases.Description: The centre and its four axis neighbours hold the same handedness. Surrounding motifs adapt through their inward observation ports, preserving fourfold symmetry while four central material passages remain visibly blocked.
